correctness.rationale: TARGET route: DRAFT proves route A for explicit E=k<x,y,z>/(x^2,y^2,zx+zy). Re-ran verify.py: all checks pass. M(c) has zero third column so e2=[0:0:1] is a global section giving lift (a,b,c)->(a,b,c,e2); projectivity promotes closed-point surjectivity to scheme surjectivity. Fibers Proj k[d]/Jc with Jc linear are P^r, r=2-rank>=0, always containing e2, hence nonempty connected. At P affine ideal and Jacobian rank exactly 2 (minor 1, char-free) give tangent dim 4>dim 3; decomposition (x1)cap(x0,y0,x2) gives A^3+A^1 intersection, so singular. Char!=2 needed for sym rank; char!=3 harmless. Distinctness counts correct.
